faqs.answer: Hello! I’m your support assistant. How can I help you today?

faqs.question: where is my order order tracking track package
faqs.answer: You can check your order status from your Orders page. If you share your order number with a human agent, they can also check the latest shipment scan.

faqs.question: I want a refund return my purchase get my money back
faqs.answer: Refunds are normally started after a return is approved. Keep your order number and reason for return ready for support.

faqs.question: how long delivery shipping time when will package arrive
faqs.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3–7 business days after dispatch. Remote locations may take longer.

faqs.question: payment failed card declined cannot pay payment methods
faqs.answer: Please verify your card details and available balance. If the payment still fails, try another supported payment method or contact your bank.

faqs.question: cancel my order stop shipment
faqs.answer: If your order has not shipped, support may be able to cancel it. Once shipped, you may need to use the return process.

faqs.question: support hours customer service open time
faqs.answer: Customer support is available Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM local time.

faqs.question: thank you thanks great helpful
faqs.answer: You’re welcome! If there’s anything else, just ask.
